title: ai-egress-approval.response
description: Response to ai-egress-approval.request.schema.json, produced by lib/omes/py/privacy/posture_projection.py's authorize_approval() (issue #217). `decision` reflects the actual, re-derived outcome - it never merely echoes the requester's `approve` flag. `reason` is a bounded operator-facing string (not a place for prompt/transcript/credential content); it always explains the outcome, including a denial reason for audit.

decision.description: 'approved' only when the requester's tenant matched the decision's tenant, decision_ref.reason_code was one of the three approval_required codes, and approve=true. 'denied' otherwise, including for a cross-tenant attempt or a reason_code outside the approvable set.
